_comment: Battlefield terrain types. Terrain is simulation data first: the battle reads these numbers, and the renderer only colours cells for the benefit of the player. move_multiplier is applied to a unit's move speed while it stands in a cell of that type - it is the first and, for this milestone, the only gameplay effect of terrain. Combat modifiers (cover, elevation advantage) are a later milestone and belong in this same table when they arrive.

terrain_types.name: Open ground
terrain_types.description: Clear, level ground. Nothing in the way of a formation.

terrain_types.name: Rough ground
terrain_types.description: Broken, tussocked earth that slows a body of men without stopping them.

terrain_types.name: Light woods
terrain_types.description: Scattered trees. Ranks cannot keep their dressing in here.

terrain_types.name: High ground
terrain_types.description: Rising ground that takes the sting out of an uphill advance.
